docs.summary: Controls how matching is performed when [`ScaleWithScreenSize`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.UI.ScaleMode~ScaleWithScreenSize) is used.
Blend between matching the width and height of the reference resolution using [`MatchWidthOrHeight`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.GameCanvas~MatchWidthOrHeight).
Expand the canvas area so it never becomes smaller than the reference resolution.
Shrink the canvas area so it never becomes larger than the reference resolution.
